frozen_before_running_on_data: 2026-10-25; rules written before harden.py was run on any size

baseline.config: <filled in by blindpd.formal: the formal config>
baseline.note: blindpd.formal replaces this table; to run blindpd.harden alone, set config and run to an existing blindpd.run output

regression_gate.description: harden.py recomputes analyse_size; per-copy cls must equal the baseline exactly and weights within tol

T1_dual_pass.stageB_vs_integer_P_vs_D: ambiguous_cross_sector (diagnostic; integer label recorded, not overridden by priority)
T1_dual_pass.mode_in_descendant_span: projected primary mode v with ||Pi_D v||^2 >= gate

span_triage.overcomplete: dim primary subspace + effective dim of descendant span inside the (C2,X,P) sector > sector dimension
span_triage.near_overlap: largest cos^2 between primary subspace and descendant span >= gate, not overcomplete

T2_algebra.identity: sum_A ||P_A psi||^2 - ||K_A psi||^2 = 6 Delta (trace of [K_mu,P_mu] = 2D); A summed with (2lf+1)/(2L+1)
T2_algebra.P_part_raw_states: exact: full-space image norm (exported Gram) minus lowering and equal-energy parts
T2_algebra.K_part_complete_if: all required lf edges present and E_s < every target frontier - atol (= KK guard)
T2_algebra.modes: window part exact; outside-window part bounded by (sum_s |v_s| sqrt(full_s - ||M_s||^2))^2
T2_algebra.role: informational only (no accepted tolerance has an independent basis); never changes revised_class
T2_algebra.scope: scalar contraction only; component-wise [K_mu,P_nu] and [D,K] operator tests are NOT done
T2_algebra.energy_shift_check: K-weighted mean of alpha(E_s-E_t) and P-window-weighted mean of alpha(E_t-E_s), expected 1

T3_window_shrink.rule: every source and target window loses its top dDelta (Delta units); frontier -> min(frontier, new top); same thresholds and parameters
T3_window_shrink.raw_level_stable: same class in every variant in which the level is still present
T3_window_shrink.mode_stable: best |<v|v'>|^2 >= gate (raw_class_weight) and |dDelta| < 0.01 in every variant where its sector survives
T3_window_shrink.claim_limit: stability against truncation of the existing windows only; not convergence to the full space

T4_kappa.role: baseline kappa threshold unchanged; variants reported only

T6_near_short.rule: primary mode m with a lower primary p (same N, same C2, Delta_p > 0.1), parity P_m = P_p (-1)^(L_p+n+L_m), multiplicity(n,L_p,L_m)>0, |Delta_m - Delta_p - n| <= tol and lambda < 1 is a candidate; measured K2_m in [0.5,2] x lambda -> consistent_with_near_short_descendant; K2_m < 0.5 lambda -> candidate_rejected_K2_small
T6_near_short.normalization_check: measured <psi|K2|psi> of guarded descendant raw levels vs lambda(parent, level, L) (independent test of the generator normalisation)

not_changed: baseline outputs, kappa threshold, raw_class_weight, family rules, tracking, OPE values; stageB sectors are not hardened (only their cross-sector conflicts are read)
